title: 10 GitHub Copilot Tips for Game Developers
author: yecats131
selftext:
I found myself having the same conversations about how to get good responses out of AI coding assistants. So, I made a video covering the 10 things I explain the most.

Also, my 12-year-old niece created the penguin animation you'll see in the video. She's teaching herself Blender and was super nervous. If you watch it and have any words of encouragement for her, I'd love to pass it along.

Note: I'm using Unity examples in the video, but the principles work for any engine or project.

I hope it helps!
